name: agentpc
description: Disposable Windows 11 and Ubuntu desktop VMs on Apple Silicon Macs for AI agents.
long_description: Create, screenshot, drive and reset local Windows 11 ARM and Ubuntu desktop VMs over MCP. Requires QEMU from Homebrew (brew install qemu) and a one-time `agentpc image build ubuntu` / `agentpc image build windows`.

tools.name: list_vms
tools.description: VMs, their state, and which images exist

tools.name: create_vm
tools.description: Create a VM from an image; ready in ~1 s (Ubuntu) or ~4 s (Windows)

tools.name: reset_vm
tools.description: Discard all changes: back to a fresh copy of the image

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command (PowerShell on Windows, bash on Ubuntu)

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from this Mac into a VM

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from a VM to this Mac

tools.name: forward_port
tools.description: Reach a server running in a VM from this Mac

tools.name: list_desktop_tools
tools.description: List the desktop-control tools inside an instance

tools.name: use_desktop_tool
tools.description: Call a desktop-control tool inside an instance
